# Uno Casa

> > Uno Casa: Premium cast iron cookware, carbon steel woks, and pizza peels with recipes and cooking guides for home chefs.

Uno Casa specializes in high-quality cast iron skillets, dutch ovens, carbon steel woks, and pizza-making tools under the HomeBuddy brand. The site features extensive recipe collections, cooking tutorials, and care guides focused on cast iron cooking, Mexican cuisine, healthy meals, and specialty cookware techniques.

## Key Topics

- cast-iron cooking
- dutch oven recipes
- carbon steel wok
- pizza peel
- HomeBuddy cookware
- tortilla recipes

- one-pot meals
- family dinner recipes

- coffee brewing
- Mexican cuisine
- comfort food
- skillet recipes
- roast chicken

## Products & Cookware

- [Pizza Peel: Make Show-Stopping Pizza at Home](https://unocasa.com/products/pizza-peel): HomeBuddy aluminum pizza peel for effortless home pizza making
- [Carbon Steel Wok - Tasty, Healthy Food in a Flash](https://unocasa.com/products/carbon-steel-wok): Uno Casa flat-bottom carbon steel wok for stir-fry and Asian cuisine

## Cast Iron Cooking Guides

- [Cast Iron Cooking Tips to Get the Most of Your Cast Iron](https://unocasa.com/blogs/tips/cast-iron-cooking): Beginner guide to cast iron cooking, seasoning, and skillet maintenance
- [10 Cast Iron Skillet Recipes Made Simple](https://unocasa.com/blogs/recipes/cast-iron-skillet): Collection of 10 quick one-pot cast-iron skillet recipes under 30 minutes
